title: Trap
tagline: Rolling hi-hats, deep bass, and sharply rhythmic vocal flows.
summary: Trap emerged from Southern hip-hop, especially Atlanta, with production built around deep 808 bass, rapid hi-hat patterns, and tense melodic loops. Its name and sound grew from local street narratives and studio innovations, then spread widely through rap and pop. Artists have continually reshaped the style, from sparse early beats to expansive, melodic productions.

pillars.name: T.I.
pillars.why: T.I.'s early-2000s work helped bring Atlanta's trap vocabulary into a prominent album format.

pillars.name: Gucci Mane
pillars.why: Gucci Mane's prolific releases and Atlanta collaborations helped establish trap as a durable local and national sound.

pillars.name: Young Jeezy
pillars.why: Young Jeezy paired stark street narratives with anthemic production, helping define a major early trap lane.
